lines.text: دوازده گانه بحرکت فلک ثامن متحرک اند چنانکه سایر صور فلا محاله از مواه اقسامی
lines.en: twelvefold, they are moved by the motion of the eighth sphere, just as the other constellations. Therefore, inevitably, from the places of the divisions

lines.text: که او را بروج اختیار کرده اند بیرون روند پس کواکب حمل بثور او دو کواکب ثور بجوزا
lines.en: which they have chosen as zodiac signs, they go out. Then the stars of Aries [go] to Taurus, and the stars of Taurus to Gemini,

lines.text: وعلی هذا القیاس چنانکه در این زمان کواکب اول حمل باخر او منتقل شده و از
lines.en: and by this analogy, just as at this time the stars of the beginning of Aries have moved to its end, and from

lines.text: صورت جوزا الا قدام او در او نمانده لیکن اهل اینفن تغییر اسما جایز ندانند
lines.en: the constellation of Gemini, except for its feet, nothing remains in it. But the people of this art do not consider changing the names permissible,

lines.text: تا تطابق ارصاد آسان باشد چه مدعا اقسام بروجست نه صور واز انتقال
lines.en: so that the correspondence of observations may be easy, for the purpose is the divisions of the zodiac signs, not the constellations. And from the transfer

lines.text: صور خللی باقسام نرسد از صور جنوبی اول صورتی که بمنطقة البروج نزدیکست منطقة
lines.en: of the constellations no defect reaches the divisions. Of the southern constellations, the first constellation that is close to the zodiac is the region of

lines.text: قیطس جنوبی است حیوانی را ماند بحری که او را دو پاست و دمی چون دم
lines.en: Cetus the southern. It resembles a sea animal that has two feet and a tail like the tail of

lines.text: مرغ کواکب او بیست و دو است از انجمله دو کوکب بر دو شعبه دم اوست بمقدار
lines.en: a bird. Its stars are twenty-two. Among them are two stars on the two branches of its tail, by the amount of

lines.text: دو نیزه از یکدگر دور انکه بطرف جنوبست قیطس جنوبی گویند و اندیگر را که
lines.en: two spears far from each other. The one that is towards the south they call Cetus the southern, and the other which

lines.text: از صغر است ذنب قیطس شمالی دویم صورت جبّار است عوام او را ترازو
lines.en: is smaller is the tail of Cetus the northern. The second is the constellation of Orion. The common people call it the Balance

lines.text: خوانند وجوزا نیز گویند چنانکه مذکور شد مردیرا ماند با کمر و شمشیر بر پا ایستاده و
lines.en: and also call it Gemini, as was mentioned. It resembles a man standing on his feet with a belt and a sword, and

lines.text: بدست راست عصائی بر بالای سر گرفته و دست چپ در استین کشیده و در
lines.en: in his right hand holding a staff above his head, and his left hand drawn into his sleeve, and in

lines.text: استین انداخته و ۳۸ ستاره است و سه ستاره کمر او را که بیکسمت اند منطقه
lines.en: his sleeve thrown. And it is 38 stars. And the three stars of his belt which are in one direction, the belt of

lines.text: الجوزا و نطاق الجوزا و نظم نظام گویند سیم صورت نهر است جوی ابرا ماند که
lines.en: Gemini, and the belt of Gemini, and the order of the system they call it. The third is the constellation of Eridanus. It resembles a stream of water that

lines.text: عطفات بسیار دارد ابتداء از زیر قدم چپ جوزا باشد و بعد از عطف باطراف
lines.en: has many bends. Its beginning is from under the left foot of Gemini, and after bending to the sides

lines.text: بکوکبی روشن منتهی شود که او را اخر النهر گویند سی و چهار ستاره است چهارم
lines.en: it ends at a bright star which they call Achernar. It is thirty-four stars. The fourth

lines.text: صورت ارنب است خرگوشی را ماند و ان سوی مغرب دو ازده ستاره است
lines.en: is the constellation of Lepus. It resembles a hare, and it is towards the west. It is twelve stars.

lines.text: پنجم صورت کلب اکبر است سگی را ماند دونده بدنبال صورت جبار از اینجهت او را
lines.en: The fifth is the constellation of Canis Major. It resembles a running dog following the constellation of Orion. For this reason they call it

lines.text: کلب الجبار گویند هجده کوکب است خارج یازده از جمله کواکب داخله کوکبیست بر دهن
lines.en: the dog of Orion. It is eighteen stars, outside eleven. Among the inside stars is a star on the mouth

summary.headline: Southern Constellations Near the Zodiac
summary.text: Discussion of zodiac signs shifting relative to the constellations while astrologers retain the traditional sign names for observational correspondence. It then describes southern constellations near the zodiac—Cetus, Orion, Eridanus, Lepus, and Canis Major—including their forms, locations, star counts, and notable stars such as Achernar.
